notes.title: Dead Horde Update Released
notes.content:
Updates to Dead Horde have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

Dead Horde
Added: Language selection in Audio options
Added: German translation
Added: Russian translation
Added: Total kills shown in the mission statistics
Fixed: thump sound in levelstats reactivated in singleplayer
Fixed: usage of the revive kit if a pre 351 build campaign was continued
Fixed: ammo glitch if shop is entered during reload
Fixed: level blocker in mission 'Junk Yard' set
Fixed: collision issue in mission 'Factory' on ruined house
Fixed: wrong 'Area clear' message after all players died
Fixed: very rare shadow mapping issue
Improved: In mission highway a dead end

notes.title: Dead Horde Update Released
notes.content:
Updates to Dead Horde have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

Dead Horde
Improved: jump distance decreased
Improved: jump animation duration decreased
Improved: jump timer refilled faster
Improved: tethering distance slightly increased
Improved: disabled shooting in forklift
Improved: number of free slots shown in server browser on hosted games
Fixed: kill stats synced in co-op play, fixes kills achievements in co-op
Fixed: endless black screen flickering if game is set to full screen on some PCs
Fixed: stability issue, if player follows an invitation and the game was not started before
Fixed: harbor - added barriers to avoid exiting the play area in one place
Fixed: harbor - vehicle can no longer enter forbidden area
Fixed: weapons attached to vehicles are now working after pressing reload button or entering vehicle during reload
Fixed: memory leak
